{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research and Development Expense Variability", "construction": "calculate the standard deviation of research and development expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D expenses may be more prone to innovation, but also face higher uncertainty, leading to higher required returns. This uncertainty can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Acceleration", "construction": "calculate the difference between the 3-year and 1-year growth rates of total employees, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating employee growth may be experiencing increasing returns to scale, but also face higher labor costs and management challenges, leading to higher required returns. This growth can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Payable Days Variability", "construction": "calculate the standard deviation of days accounts payable over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with volatile accounts payable days may be facing higher supplier credit risk, leading to higher required returns. This risk can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Property, Plant, and Equipment Renewal Rate", "construction": "calculate the ratio of capital expenditures to net property, plant, and equipment over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with high renewal rates may be investing in new technologies and processes, leading to higher productivity and growth, but also face higher depreciation and obsolescence risk, leading to higher required returns. This investment can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Foreign Sales Concentration", "construction": "calculate the Herfindahl index of foreign sales by region over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated foreign sales may be more exposed to regional economic shocks, leading to higher required returns. This exposure can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Cash Flow Volatility", "construction": "calculate the standard deviation of operating cash flows over the past 5 years, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with volatile cash flows may be facing higher financial distress risk, leading to higher required returns. This risk can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Intangible Asset Intensity", "construction": "calculate the ratio of intangible assets to total assets over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with high intangible asset intensity may be more prone to innovation and growth, but also face higher obsolescence and impairment risk, leading to higher required returns. This intensity can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "calculate the Herfindahl index of sales by customer over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated customer bases may be more exposed to customer-specific risks, leading to higher required returns. This exposure can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Complexity", "construction": "calculate the number of unique suppliers and customers over the past year, scaled by total assets", "rationale": "Firms with complex supply chains may be facing higher operational and logistical risks, leading to higher required returns. This complexity can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Structure", "construction": "calculate the ratio of independent directors to total board members over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with strong corporate governance structures may be more prone to shareholder value creation, but also face higher agency costs, leading to higher required returns. This structure can lead to higher average returns for these firms.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
